 E-commerce sellers are eagerly anticipating the year-end shopping season.
 Content commerce and livestreaming are becoming new drivers of the e-commerce market, as consumers are not only looking for good prices but also tend to combine entertainment, interaction, and shopping.
 Báo Đầu tư • 21/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The year-end online shopping season is witnessing a notable shift: from a transaction model primarily based on product search and price comparison to a shopping experience that combines entertainment content and direct interaction. Shopee's business results during this year's 11.11 campaign partly reflect this trend, with the total transaction value (GMV) on Shopee Live increasing 12 times compared to a normal day.
 According to Shopee, on the peak day of November 11th, the number of orders generated through livestreaming increased ninefold compared to a normal day. Meanwhile, Shopee Live and Shopee Video recorded a total of nearly 2.5 billion views throughout the campaign. These figures show that livestreaming and short videos are gradually moving beyond their role as promotional tools, becoming a significant channel for driving transactions in the e-commerce market.
 Notably, the growth stems not only from consumer traffic but also from changes in how sellers conduct their business. On November 11th alone, the number of livestream sessions conducted by sellers and brands on the platform tripled compared to a normal day. The number of new products listed also increased sevenfold.
 This reflects a growing trend: businesses and retailers are no longer competing solely on price or product range, but must invest more in their ability to tell product stories, interact with customers, and create compelling online shopping experiences. 
 On the peak day of November 11th, the number of orders placed via livestream increased ninefold compared to a normal day. 
 Content commerce is becoming a growth driver.
 One of the highlights of this year's 11/11 campaign is how Shopee combines entertainment activities with promotions and deals on its platform.
 Ahead of the shopping festival, the platform launched a media campaign in collaboration with the band UPRIZE, through the TV commercial "Abracadabra Shopee 11/11 - The Biggest Sale of the Year". According to the company's statistics, the TV commercial and accompanying content recorded over 26 million views and interactions across official media channels.
 The online music event "Top Live Stars," held on November 10th, also attracted over 7 million views on Shopee Live and other online streaming platforms. The program combined artistic performances, a 360-degree stage, and in-stream shopping deals.
 Meanwhile, the "One Click to Win a Flight Ticket" program recorded nearly 30 million entries on the app.
 These activities demonstrate that e-commerce platforms are expanding their approach to consumers, rather than simply focusing on physically placing products in front of customers. Entertainment content, celebrities, interactive games, and livestreaming are integrated into an experiential journey, where the line between viewing content and shopping is increasingly blurred.
 For consumers, this format makes product discovery more intuitive. Instead of just reading descriptions or viewing images, customers can watch sellers introduce products, ask questions, receive advice, and access special offers directly during the livestream.
 From the seller's perspective, this is an opportunity to reach new customers, increase the conversion rate of views into orders, and build direct relationships with consumers.
 You may also like However, the effectiveness of the content commerce model lies not simply in its ability to attract views. The ability to convert interest into actual transactions is the decisive factor in determining the business value of this sales channel. The fact that Shopee Live's GMV increased 12 times, while the number of orders via livestream increased 9 times on November 11th, are noteworthy indicators of the platform's potential for content commercialization. 
 Shopee Live's GMV increased 12-fold, and the number of orders placed via livestream increased 9-fold on November 11th. 
 Get ready for the year-end shopping season!
 Beyond reflecting the appeal of interactive shopping formats, the results of the 11.11 campaign also demonstrate the increasingly proactive preparation of the seller community before peak consumer periods.
 The sevenfold increase in the number of new products listed and the threefold increase in livestream sessions show that sellers are actively expanding their supply, refreshing their content, and leveraging digital tools to reach buyers.
 This is a noteworthy development in the context of an increasingly competitive e-commerce market. With consumers having more choices and the ability to easily compare prices between sellers, differentiating the user experience, quality of advice, and product descriptions becomes a crucial advantage.
 According to Shopee, during the 11/11 campaign, the most popular product categories chosen by consumers included fashion (clothing), facial skincare products, beverages, snacks, and household cleaning products. These are all highly practical product categories that are closely related to daily consumer needs.
 Notably, products of Vietnamese origin continue to be present in many selected product categories. This opens up opportunities for domestic businesses and brands to expand their market through digital distribution channels, especially as customer access is no longer limited by geography.
 In addition, promotional programs continue to play a crucial role in stimulating consumer demand. According to Shopee's statistics, Vietnamese consumers saved up to 16 trillion VND during the 11/11 event thanks to promotional programs from the platform, brands, and sellers.
 Mr. Tran Tuan Anh, CEO of Shopee Vietnam, noted that online consumers are increasingly interested not only in convenience and cost optimization but also in the experience, wanting more ways to discover, interact with, and choose products.
 According to Mr. Tuan Anh, the year-end shopping season and Tet (Lunar New Year) 2027 will open up many opportunities for sellers and businesses to reach consumers amidst increasingly diverse shopping needs and trends. Shopee will continue to invest in technology, enhance the shopping experience, and develop solutions to support sellers.
 E-commerce competition is shifting to a race for customer experience.
 The results of the 11/11 campaign show that competition in the e-commerce market is entering a new phase. While previously advantages were primarily derived from price, delivery speed, product catalog size, and promotional policies, now the ability to create engaging content and organize interactive experiences is also becoming a crucial competitive factor.
 You may also like Livestreaming and short videos help bridge the gap between sellers and buyers, creating more touchpoints in the consumer journey. This also provides an opportunity for small and medium-sized enterprises and local brands to reach a wider market without necessarily investing in large-scale physical store systems.
 However, to effectively capitalize on this trend, sellers need to shift from a view-driven mindset to building a long-term content commerce strategy. Product quality, information transparency, consulting capabilities, after-sales service, and brand reputation remain crucial factors in retaining customers.
 For platforms, the challenge is not just increasing traffic, but also ensuring transaction quality, protecting consumer rights, and building a healthy business environment. As livestreaming becomes increasingly integrated with sales activities, the need to control product information, origin, and the authenticity of promotional content also needs to be emphasized.
 For the Vietnamese market, the year-end shopping season and Tet (Lunar New Year) 2027 will continue to be a test of businesses' adaptability on digital platforms. Sellers who combine quality products, engaging content, technology, and customer service are more likely to build a sustainable competitive advantage.
 In the upcoming e-commerce race, businesses that create engaging, trustworthy shopping experiences capable of delivering real value will have a greater chance of dominating the market.
